verdict.rationale: OCI documents its services as typical REST APIs over HTTPS. It commits to 12 months' notice before breaking API changes, and it backs the API with official SDKs and a CLI that covers the same core functionality as the Console. That gives an AI-native user a documented, programmatic way to drive the product. The probe found no OpenAPI spec at the guessed docs.oracle.com paths, but that is a gap in machine-readable discovery, not evidence the API is missing. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI), independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven API use.
